superseded: Only corrected-engine (post S69) results are built; all earlier randomised results are excluded.
flat_caption: Engine: Warp GPU (MuJoCo-Warp 3.17, float32), corrected for the S69 stale-subtree-mass error. Domain randomisation: off. Observation noise: off. Worlds per cell: 64 per cell. Seeds: one per row as listed (seeds 0 and 1 where both are shown). Protocol: perfectly flat 24 m world on interior tiles (at least 7.5 m from the map border, the S92 correction), nominal design, constant velocity command at a random heading, 800 control steps, error and achieved/commanded speed averaged over steps 300 to 799 of worlds still upright, falls = share of worlds that fell (eval_battery.py; every flat row re-run after S92). Error is the Euclidean velocity error in m/s. All learned rows are corrected-engine runs. The LQR-alone row is the interior-tile re-measurement of the S92 addendum (source: lqr_flat_interior.log); a dagger marks values taken from the log.

tradeoff.label: authority 0.5, arrestors added at evaluation only

pending.g27_scale_rs025_mu01_s0: trained; step-size curves being re-run at its own friction 0.01, see S102

videos.name: c1_goal_ramp
videos.title: LQR + residual, goal on an 11 degree ramp
videos.description: g12_res_s0 reaches the goal on the ramp; no fall in 8 s. Ramp-up goals are the residual's best kind (success 0.74 and 0.69 over 176 worlds each).

videos.name: c1_goal_step
videos.title: LQR + residual, goal across a 2.3 cm step (falls)
videos.description: g12_res_s0 falls at the step after 3.0 s. Step-up goals succeed in about one world in three (0.33 and 0.28 over 176 worlds each), so most steps end like this one.

videos.name: c1_goal_flat
videos.title: LQR + residual, goal on a flat tile (falls)
videos.description: g12_res_s0 falls after 4.8 s on a flat tile. Flat-tile goal success is about 0.6 to 0.7, so a fall here is not rare; it is shown because failures are part of the record.

videos.name: c2_flat_nocage
videos.title: Same policy, flat tile, arrestors off (falls)
videos.description: g12_dr175_s0 without arrestors: the body derails off the ball and the robot falls after 4.8 s.

videos.name: c2_flat_cage100
videos.title: Same policy, flat tile, arrestors on
videos.description: The same policy and world with the 100 deg arrestors added at evaluation (zero-shot): no fall in 8 s.

videos.name: c2_step_up_nocage
videos.title: Same policy, 2.3 cm step, arrestors off (falls)
videos.description: g12_dr175_s0 without arrestors falls at the step after 2.9 s.

videos.name: c2_step_up_cage100
videos.title: Same policy, 2.3 cm step, arrestors on (falls later)
videos.description: The same policy and world with arrestors falls too, later (5.5 s): the retainer prevents derailing, not every fall.

videos.name: c3_step_up_pure_nocage
videos.title: Pure learning on a step-up, without arrestors (falls)
videos.description: Pure learning trained without arrestors (g12_pure_s0) falls at the 2.3 cm step after 2.8 s.

videos.name: c3_step_up_pure_cage
videos.title: Pure learning on a step-up, with arrestors
videos.description: Pure learning trained with the arrestors (g16_pure_ret100_s1, a different policy from the clip above) crosses toward the goal and does not fall in 8 s.

videos.name: c4_step_up_rs025_cage
videos.title: Recommended controller: step-up toward a goal
videos.description: LQR + residual at authority 0.25 trained with the arrestors (g18_ret_rs025_s1) climbs the 2.3 cm step toward the goal and holds for 8 s.

videos.name: c4_ramp_vel06_rs025_cage
videos.title: Recommended controller: 0.6 m/s up an 11 degree ramp (known weakness, falls)
videos.description: The same controller following a 0.6 m/s command up an 11 degree ramp lags the command (0.40 m/s at 2.8 s) and falls at 5.6 s. A known weakness, shown as a single clip, not a statistic.

videos.name: c6_nav_blind
videos.title: Navigation, blind: falls into the block
videos.description: The recommended balance controller driven straight at the goal with no terrain information rolls onto the 8 cm block and falls.

videos.name: c6_nav_oracle
videos.title: Navigation with the perfect height map: goes around the block
videos.description: The same frozen controller with the wavefront planner on the privileged height map steers around the block end and reaches the goal.

videos.name: c7_step4cm_s075
videos.title: A 5 cm step, 6.75 cm ball: falls
videos.description: The scale policy on the 0.75-scale robot (ball radius 6.75 cm, predicted limit 2.0 cm) drives into a 5 cm up-step at 0.26 m/s, stalls against the edge and falls at 6.6 s.

videos.name: c7_step4cm_s2
videos.title: The same 5 cm step, 18 cm ball: crosses
videos.description: The same policy on the 2-scale robot (ball radius 18 cm, predicted limit 5.2 cm) climbs the same 5 cm step and drives on; no fall in the 8 s clip.

videos.name: c6_nav_tof18
videos.title: Navigation with the forward ToF sensor (18 x 14): hesitates, then arrives
videos.description: The same controller and planner with the head-mounted ToF sensor hesitates while its obstacle memory fills in, then goes around the block and reaches the goal at 16.5 s. A single clip.
